steps.code:
# Compute most common genre for each playlist
from collections import Counter

playlist_genres = {}
for pl in playlists:
    genres = [song_details[sid]['genre'] for sid in pl['song_ids']]
    genre_counts = Counter(genres)
    most_common = genre_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    playlist_genres[pl['playlist_id']] = most_common
    print(f"Playlist {pl['playlist_id']} '{pl['title']}': most common genre = {most_common}")
